description: Regulatory enforcement history for a bank, fintech, money services business, crypto firm or individual: consent orders, civil money penalties, fines, final notices, bars and charges from the Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, FinCEN, SEC, CFTC and the UK FCA, pulled continuously from the regulators' own releases. Returns match / possible_match / no_match with each action's authority, date, type, title and link. Use in vendor onboarding, correspondent due diligence, KYB and partner reviews.

years.description: Only actions from the last N years (default: all)

name: screen_enforcement
title: Enforcement history
